# Math Fundamentals — Before Vectors

Book Chapter 1 revisits equations, numbers, functions, geometry, vectors and complex numbers. Our two worked chapters isolate the prerequisites used throughout this path.

## Follow the chapters

1. [solving equations](01-solving-equations.qmd)
2. [functions and vectors](02-functions-and-vectors.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Math Fundamentals — Before Vectors. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
